summary: AFS Group. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

insights.one_liner: AFS Group is a small, employee-owned Amsterdam broker in financial and environmental commodities with a very international team, but it is not a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: AFS has a team of 195+ people from 25+ nationalities, serving 3,000+ clients in 50+ countries.
It is an independent, employee-owned intermediary with more than 175 years of history; AFS Energy focuses on environmental commodities.
Its risk team covers market, credit, liquidity and currency risk and reports directly to the Risk Director and CEO.

open.text: AFS is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its one current job here, an entry-level risk role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.

worth_knowing.text: AFS Group B.V.'s ultimate parent is registered as Clip Brokers B.V. in the Netherlands.
